**Finding: deviation (MFN — medium severity)**

§ 7.2 places the MFN burden on us rather than on Cobalt Cloud: before engaging another provider, we would have to disclose and match, for Vendor's benefit, any more favourable commercial offer we receive. It is unbounded as to product, duration and comparability, which fails the fallback (defined product, 12 months, reasonable-comparison carve-outs) and lands in walk-away territory. It also contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we made no most-favoured-customer commitment.

Redline (validated, preferred position): delete ¶ p0026 in full. No Vendor-granted MFN exists elsewhere in the document, so nothing in our favour is lost. This also disposes of the exclusivity-flavoured "before engaging another provider" trigger in the same sentence, so the EXCLUSIVITY rule should not re-cut it.
